ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_VOLUME_PIMGR
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure check_volume_PIMGR
 (p_unit_id in varchar2,
 p_coll_date in date ,
 p_chapter_id in varchar2,
 p_product_code in varchar2,
 p_volume in number,
 p_prod_Category IN VARCHAR2 ) is
 temp_max_weight number;
 temp_min_weight number;
 temp_u_id varchar2(10) := name_in('banner.user_id');
 temp_p_name varchar2(30) := name_in('banner.prog_name');
 chp_sysdate DATE;
 n_final_minVol NUMBER;
 n_final_maxVol NUMBER;
 
 CURSOR vprc_cur IS 
 SELECT final_min_volume, final_max_volume
 FROM valid_patho_reduction_config vprc, pathogen_reduction_details pred
 WHERE vprc.volume_type_set = pred.vol_type_set
 AND vprc.suspension_type = pred.suspension_type
 AND vprc.equip_type = pred.equip_type
 AND pred.unit_id = p_unit_id
 ANd vprc.chapter_id = p_chapter_id
 AND chp_sysdate BETWEEN vprc.eff_date AND NVL(vprc.term_date, chp_sysdate+1);

 CURSOR vprc_PLAS_cur IS 
 SELECT final_min_volume, final_max_volume
 FROM valid_patho_reduction_config vprc, pathogen_reduction_details pred
 WHERE vprc.volume_type_set = pred.vol_type_set
 --AND vprc.suspension_type = pred.suspension_type
 --AND vprc.equip_type = pred.equip_type
 AND pred.unit_id = p_unit_id
 ANd vprc.chapter_id = p_chapter_id
 AND chp_sysdate BETWEEN vprc.eff_date AND NVL(vprc.term_date, chp_sysdate+1); 
begin
 
 chp_sysdate := lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(p_chapter_id, SYSDATE);
 
 IF p_prod_category = 'PLT' THEN
 OPEN vprc_cur;
 FETCH vprc_cur INTO n_final_minVol, n_final_maxVol;
 CLOSE vprc_cur;
 ELSIF p_prod_category = 'PLAS' THEN
 OPEN vprc_PLAS_cur;
 FETCH vprc_PLAS_cur INTO n_final_minVol, n_final_maxVol;
 CLOSE vprc_PLAS_cur;
 END IF;
 
 IF n_final_minVOl IS NULL OR n_final_maxVol IS NULL THEN
 message('Error in selecting final volume from Pathogen configuration table');
 RAISE form_trigger_failure;
 END IF;
 --MESSAGE('VOLUME ' || P_VOLUME);PAUSE;
 --MESSAGE('VOLUME 1 ' || n_final_minVol);PAUSE;
 --MESSAGE('VOLUME 2' || n_final_maxVol);PAUSE;
 IF p_volume NOT BETWEEN n_final_minVol AND n_final_maxVol THEN
 show_error('9789','CMW');

 begin
 insert into component_interdictions
 (unit_id, coll_date, chapter_id, product_code,
 inter_code, insert_dats, inter_user_id,
 program_id)
 select p_unit_id,p_coll_date,p_chapter_id,
 p_product_code,inter_code,sysdate,
 temp_u_id,temp_p_name
 from valid_interdictions_lab --- LT 2018
 where system_inter_code = 'CMW' and
 inter_code not in (select inter_code
 from component_interdictions
 where unit_id = p_unit_id
 and trunc(coll_date) =
 trunc(p_coll_date)
 and product_code = p_product_code
 and chapter_id = p_chapter_id)
 and --sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+365) --- 6945
 lifetrack_timezone_convert.is_current_date(p_chapter_id,eff_date,term_date,SYSDATE) = 'Y';
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 message ('Error in inserting into comp_inter');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end;
 ELSE
 delete from component_interdictions
 where unit_id = p_unit_id
 and trunc(coll_date) = trunc(p_coll_date)
 and product_code = p_product_code 
 and chapter_id = p_chapter_id
 and inter_code in (select inter_code 
 from valid_interdictions_lab -- LT 2018
 where system_inter_code = 'CMW'
 and --sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate) --- 6945
 lifetrack_timezone_convert.is_current_date(p_chapter_id,eff_date,term_date,SYSDATE) = 'Y');

 END IF; 
 
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: PATHOGEN_PRODUCT_UPDATE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE pathogen_product_update IS
 lv_prod_cat VARCHAR2(10);
 nCnt NUMBER;
BEGIN
 SELECT COUNT(1) INTO nCnt
 FROM pathogen_final_products
 WHERE unit_id = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id
 AND product_code = :ctrl_blk_1.product_code;
 
 IF nCnt <> 0 THEN
 -- get the product category
 BEGIN
 SELECT prd.prod_category into lv_prod_cat
 FROM pathogen_final_products pfp, pathogen_reduction_details prd
 WHERE pfp.unit_id = prd.unit_id
 AND pfp.suit_prod_code = prd.suit_prod_code
 AND pfp.unit_id = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id
 AND pfp.product_code = :ctrl_blk_1.product_code ;
 EXCEPTION 
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 lv_prod_cat := null;
 END;
 UPDATE pathogen_final_products
 SET prod_weight = :ctrl_blk_1.component_weight,
 prod_vol = :ctrl_blk_1.comp_vol,
 anticoagulant_volume = NVL(:ctrl_blk_1.anticoagulant_volume, anticoagulant_volume),
 program_id = :banner.prog_name
 WHERE unit_id = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id
 AND product_code = :ctrl_blk_1.product_code;
 
 If lv_prod_cat is not null and :ctrl_blk_1.comp_vol is not null THEN
 check_volume_PIMGR (
 p_unit_id => :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id, 
 p_coll_date => :ctrl_blk_1.coll_date,
 p_chapter_id => :GLOBAL.chapter_id,
 p_product_code => :ctrl_blk_1.product_code, 
 p_volume => :ctrl_blk_1.comp_vol,
 p_prod_category => lv_prod_cat
 );
 check_package_failure;
 end if; 
 END IF;
END;
